name: Egg Omelet
instructions: Beat 2 eggs, add salt and pepper. Heat butter in a pan, pour eggs and fold when cooked. Serve hot.

name: Chicken Soup
instructions: Boil chicken in water with carrots, celery, and onions for 45 minutes. Season with salt and pepper. Add noodles if desired.

name: Spaghetti Bolognese
instructions: Brown 400g minced beef with a chopped onion and 2 garlic cloves. Add a can of crushed tomatoes, 2 tbsp tomato paste, salt, pepper, and dried oregano. Simmer for 20 minutes. Cook spaghetti al dente, drain, and serve topped with the sauce and grated Parmesan.

name: Tomato Basil Soup
instructions: Sauté a chopped onion and 2 garlic cloves in olive oil until soft. Add 600g chopped tomatoes and 400ml vegetable broth. Simmer 20 minutes, then blend until smooth. Stir in fresh basil, salt, and pepper. Serve with crusty bread.

name: Banana Pancakes
instructions: Mash 2 ripe bananas in a bowl. Mix in 2 eggs, 1/2 cup flour, 1/2 cup milk, and a pinch of salt until smooth. Heat a lightly buttered pan over medium heat. Pour small ladles of batter and cook until bubbles form, then flip. Serve with honey or maple syrup.

name: Grilled Cheese Sandwich
instructions: Butter one side of each of 2 bread slices. Place one slice butter-side-down in a pan over medium heat. Layer with 2 slices of cheese. Top with the second slice butter-side-up. Cook 3 minutes per side until golden and the cheese has melted. Serve immediately.

name: Chicken Stir-Fry
instructions: Slice 500g chicken breast thin. Heat oil in a wok over high heat, cook chicken 5 minutes. Add sliced bell peppers, carrots, and broccoli. Stir-fry 4 minutes. Mix 3 tbsp soy sauce, 1 tbsp oyster sauce, and 1 tsp sesame oil; pour over. Toss well and serve over steamed rice.

name: Apple Cinnamon Oatmeal
instructions: Bring 2 cups of milk to a gentle simmer. Stir in 1 cup rolled oats and cook 5 minutes, stirring occasionally. Dice 1 apple and add it along with 1 tsp cinnamon and a pinch of salt. Cook 2 more minutes. Sweeten with honey and serve warm.

name: Vegetable Stew
instructions: Dice and sauté an onion and 2 garlic cloves in olive oil. Add diced potatoes, carrots, celery, and zucchini. Pour in 600ml vegetable broth and a can of diced tomatoes. Season with thyme, rosemary, salt, and pepper. Simmer 30 minutes until vegetables are tender.

name: Caprese Salad
instructions: Slice 3 large tomatoes and 200g fresh mozzarella into rounds. Alternate tomato and mozzarella slices on a plate. Tuck fresh basil leaves between slices. Drizzle with extra-virgin olive oil and balsamic glaze. Season with salt and freshly ground black pepper.

name: Pasta Carbonara
instructions: Boil spaghetti in salted water. Meanwhile, cook bacon in a pan until lightly browned. In a bowl, whisk eggs with sour cream and grated Parmesan. Drain pasta and immediately toss with the bacon, egg mixture, salt, and pepper. Finish with extra Parmesan.

name: Pasta with Tomato and Mushroom Sauce
instructions: Boil pasta in salted water. Sauté a chopped onion, then add mushrooms (fresh or canned) and cook until tender. Stir in tomato sauce and simmer until creamy. Drain pasta and mix with the sauce. Sprinkle with grated Parmesan to serve.

name: Green Salad with Tuna and Corn
instructions: Wash and tear lettuce leaves into a bowl. Drain the canned tuna and corn, then add them to the salad. Drizzle with olive oil and freshly squeezed lemon juice. Season with salt and toss gently to combine.

name: Cheese and Herb Omelet
instructions: Beat 3–4 eggs in a deep bowl. Stir in grated cheese and finely chopped fresh herbs (spring onion, green garlic, or dill). Season with salt. Heat a drizzle of extra-virgin olive oil in a pan, pour in the mixture, and cook over medium heat for about 15 minutes until set.

name: Asian-Style Rice with Chicken
instructions: Cook rice in a rice cooker with 2 tbsp oil and water according to package directions. Meanwhile, grill chicken breast on a grill pan until cooked through. Dice the chicken into small cubes. When rice is done, mix with the chicken and drizzle soy sauce to taste.

name: Turkey Breast on a Bed of Vegetables
instructions: Line a baking tray with parchment paper. Spread frozen vegetables over it and drizzle with olive oil, salt, and pepper. Lay turkey breast slices on top and season with salt. Bake in a preheated oven until the turkey is golden and cooked through. Optionally use fresh vegetables sliced into rounds and seasoned with herbs.

name: Cream of Mushroom Soup
instructions: Clean 1 kg of champignon mushrooms and boil them until tender. Finely chop one large onion. Drain the mushrooms and place them in a blender together with the onion and cooking cream. Blend until smooth and creamy. Season with salt and pepper to taste.

name: Chicken and Cheese Puff Pastry Braid
instructions: Dice chicken breast into small cubes and lightly brown in a pan. Roll out puff pastry dough. Place the chicken, canned mushrooms, and grated cheese down the center. Season with salt and pepper. Fold the dough over in a braid shape, brush the top with beaten egg, and bake until golden and crispy.

name: Flatbread Pizza
instructions: Place flatbreads on a parchment-lined baking tray. Spread tomato sauce over each one. Top with salami, bacon, mushrooms, olives, and corn to taste. Sprinkle generously with grated cheese. Bake in a preheated oven until the cheese is melted and bubbly.

name: Chicken Skewers in a Pan
instructions: Thread cubed chicken breast, red bell pepper, mushrooms, cherry tomatoes, olives, and onion onto skewer sticks. Season with a pinch of salt. Cook the skewers in a grill pan, turning occasionally, until the chicken is browned and cooked through.

name: Crispy Sandwich
instructions: Toast 2 slices of bread, then spread with butter. Layer with pressed ham and plenty of cheese slices. Add fresh lettuce, sliced cucumber, or red bell pepper for freshness. Top with grated cheese and bake in the oven on a flat tray for about 10 minutes until the cheese has melted.

name: French Potato Pudding
instructions: Wash and dice potatoes into small cubes; boil until tender. Transfer to an oven-safe dish and mix with grated telemea (feta-style) cheese, well-beaten eggs, butter, and a pinch of salt. Bake in the oven until the top is nicely browned.

name: Rice with Mexican Vegetables
instructions: Boil long-grain rice in salted water until cooked. Meanwhile, sauté fresh or frozen mixed vegetables in a pan with a knob of butter until tender. Combine the cooked rice and vegetables, season with salt and pepper, and serve hot.

name: Chicken with Mushrooms in Cream Sauce
instructions:
Cut the chicken breast into cubes. In a pan with oil, brown the meat over medium heat, stirring frequently. Remove the chicken to a plate.
In the same pan, sauté the finely chopped onion for 2-3 minutes. Add the sliced mushrooms, season with salt and pepper, and cook until golden.
Pour in 400 ml of heavy cream and cook for a few minutes until the sauce thickens slightly.
Add the chicken back and stir well. Sprinkle with freshly chopped parsley, cover with a lid, and leave for 2-3 minutes. Serve warm.

name: Pork and Potato Stew
instructions:
Cut the pork neck into cubes and coat them in flour. Place in a pot together with the diced smoked bacon and a little oil. Brown the meat well on all sides, then set aside.
In the same oil, sauté the diced onion for 2 minutes. Add the minced garlic and sliced carrot, and sauté for another 1-2 minutes.
Add the tomato sauce, browned meat, and 500 ml of clear broth or water. Season with salt, pepper, and a bay leaf. Cover and cook over low heat for 1 hour.
Add the diced potatoes and cook for another 20 minutes or until tender. Serve warm.

name: Oven-Baked Chicken with Potatoes
instructions:
Peel and slice the potatoes (≈0.5 cm thick). Toss in a bowl with olive oil, salt, and thyme.
Pour 2-3 tbsp of olive oil into a baking tray. Slice the 4 onions and spread them evenly in the tray. Layer the seasoned potatoes on top.
Blend the garlic (5 cloves), milk, sunflower oil, tomato paste, paprika, thyme, salt, and pepper until you get a smooth sauce.
Place the chicken thighs over the potatoes, pour the sauce over the meat, and tuck in the asparagus and the whole garlic head.
Bake at 220°C for 60 minutes. Serve immediately.

name: Penne Quattro Formaggi
instructions: Boil 250g penne according to package instructions, about 8 minutes until al dente. Separately, prepare the sauce. Melt butter in a pan and add cream, salt and pepper to taste. Cut the cheeses into small pieces if not already grated, and when the cream starts to boil, add them to the pan. Mix everything for 5 minutes until all ingredients have melted and combined perfectly. Let the sauce thicken for 2-3 more minutes on low heat. Add the penne using two spatulas and mix well. Sprinkle with oregano before serving.

name: Pasta Arrabiata
instructions: Boil spaghetti in salted water for about 8 minutes until al dente, then rinse under cold water. Separately, prepare the sauce. Clean the hot peppers from seeds, slice them into 2-3 cm pieces and put them in a pan with 4-5 tbsp oil. Add finely chopped garlic and let everything sauté for 3 minutes. Deglaze with a little water and add the tomato sauce. In 10 minutes the arrabiata sauce is almost ready. Add lemon juice, parmesan and 2 tbsp olive oil. Mix the pasta with the sauce and serve with grated parmesan on top.

name: Pasta with Chicken and Pesto
instructions: Remove chicken from refrigerator 30 minutes before cooking to reach room temperature. Boil the pasta and prepare the pesto sauce. Using a blender, blend raw basil, cashews, garlic, parmesan, 2 tbsp olive oil, lemon juice, salt and pepper to taste. This process should take no more than 10 minutes. When the pesto sauce is ready, lightly brush the chicken breast pieces with it and let them reach room temperature for 20-30 minutes. Using a suitable pan, heat 2 tbsp olive oil and cook the meat until fully fried. Add cherry tomatoes and sauté for 5 minutes. When the chicken breast is ready, cut it into thin pieces and mix with the pasta, sauce, and cherry tomatoes. Serve with grated parmesan on top.

name: Pasta with Shrimp
instructions: Boil water and when it starts to boil, add the pasta. Separately, peel the shrimp by first removing the head, then the shell and intestine. Don't throw away the remains; boil them in a little water just to cover them. Let them boil for a few minutes, then pour the broth into a glass separately as you will need it later. While the shrimp are boiling, heat oil, butter, garlic, and finely chopped hot pepper in a pan. Mix gently for 3 minutes. Add the shrimp and let them sauté for 2 minutes. When the shrimp turn pink, add a glass of the broth and let everything boil for 3-4 minutes. Then add lemon juice, salt and pepper. Mix well and finally add the pasta and parsley to the pan. Serve with grated parmesan on top and a glass of white wine.

name: Pasta with Garlic and Hot Pepper
instructions: First, boil the spaghetti according to package instructions, then slice the pepper and garlic, and finely chop the parsley. Sauté the garlic and pepper for a few minutes. Add 2 ladles of the water in which the pasta was boiled, then add the finely chopped parsley. Leave the pan on the heat for a few minutes and finally add the cooked pasta to the pan. Season the pasta with salt and other spices such as basil. Mix everything well and serve the spaghetti with grated parmesan on top.

name: Baked Salmon with Asparagus
instructions: Preheat the oven and grease a baking tray with olive oil. Place the salmon fillets and season with salt and pepper. Mix olive oil, garlic, herbs, and juice from half a lemon. Pour this sauce over the salmon fillets, ensuring it covers all surfaces. Wash the asparagus and cut off the woody stems. Arrange asparagus in the tray and drizzle with olive oil. Place asparagus around the edges with salmon in the center. Slice the remaining lemon thinly and cover each piece of salmon with a slice. Bake for 12-15 minutes or until the fish is opaque and flaky when tested with a fork. Garnish with fresh thyme or parsley and serve alongside the asparagus.

name: Baked Salmon with Vegetables
instructions: Remove salmon from refrigerator and let it reach room temperature for about 15 minutes. Preheat the oven. In a small bowl, mix melted butter and lemon juice. Using a brush, apply the butter mixture over the salmon fillets in a baking dish. Sprinkle with chopped garlic, salt, and pepper. Bake for 12 to 15 minutes. Meanwhile, cut the vegetables according to their density so they cook evenly. Cauliflower can remain medium-sized florets, while broccoli should be separated into smaller florets. Place vegetables with cut side down in another baking tray and drizzle with olive oil. Do not overcrowd the tray. Bake vegetables for 30 minutes. When done, sprinkle with fresh parsley and dill for extra flavor. Serve the salmon alongside the roasted vegetables.

name: Classic Beef Soup
instructions: Wash and clean the vegetables, then cut the carrots into rounds, and dice the celery, bell pepper, and potatoes. Finely chop the onion. Put approximately 4 liters of water in a pot and add the diced beef. Let the meat boil until foam forms on top (approximately 20 minutes), which you will remove with a skimmer. Let the meat boil for another 20-30 minutes, removing foam occasionally. Once no more foam forms, add the onion, carrots, and celery and let them boil for another 20-30 minutes. Then add the bell pepper, peas, and potatoes and let them boil for 15 minutes. Once cooked, add the tomato juice, a little salt and olive oil, and let the soup boil for another 15 minutes. When the soup is ready, add the chopped parsley and serve.

name: Sour Beef Soup
instructions: Start by putting the beef on the bone to boil in cold water with salt. Boil the meat over low heat while removing the foam that forms on the surface. Optionally, to cook the beef faster, you can use a pressure cooker. Meanwhile, prepare the root vegetables. Clean, wash and finely chop the onion, and cut the carrots, celery, and parsley root into cubes. Once no more foam forms, pierce the meat with a fork to see if it's cooked more than halfway. You should encounter some resistance. Then add the root vegetables. Let the soup boil over low heat while you prepare the remaining vegetables. Cut the pepper into cubes, peel and cube the potatoes. Once the root vegetables start to soften, add the pepper, peas, and finely chopped white cabbage. Meanwhile, check if the meat is cooked. When the fork goes in easily, remove it from the pot, let it cool slightly, then cut into cubes. Put the meat back in the pot. When the vegetables are almost cooked, add the potatoes. Once they're cooked, add the tomatoes that you've previously scalded, peeled, and cubed. Boil the bors separately and add it to the soup. Let the contents come to two boils and remove the pot from heat. Add salt and pepper to taste, as well as finely chopped lovage. Serve with a little sour cream.

name: Transylvanian Veal Soup with Sour Cream
instructions: Start by putting the veal to boil together with the veal bones in a pot with cold water, salt, and a few peppercorns. Let the meat boil for approximately 45 minutes, during which you will skim constantly until the broth remains clear. Meanwhile, wash and clean the vegetables. Cut the potatoes into cubes, carrots into rounds, parsnip, parsley root, and celery into cubes, and finely chop the onion. Add two tablespoons of oil to a pan and briefly sauté the carrots. When the meat is almost cooked, remove it from the pot and cut into cubes. Strain the soup separately into another pot, add the veal and prepared vegetables. Let everything boil and add celery and parsley leaves. You can add water if the broth has reduced. When the veal soup boils, add the thyme sprig, bay leaf, pepper, and a little ground cumin. Then add two level tablespoons of sweet paprika and tomato juice. Let everything boil until the vegetables are soft. Season with more salt if needed. When the veal soup is cooked, remove the celery leaves and thyme sprig. Prepare the egg yolk and sour cream mixture to finish the soup. Mix the sour cream with the egg yolks and 2 tablespoons of soup until the mixture thins, then add it to the soup and mix well. Optionally, add a little lemon juice to taste.

name: Country-Style Beef Soup
instructions: Remove the meat from the bone and wash it well, then cut it into cubes. Put the cubed meat and bones to boil in a pot with water and salt for approximately one hour. Skim constantly until the broth remains clear. The meat should be soft when pierced with a fork. Meanwhile, prepare the vegetables and remove the bones from the pot. Wash, clean, and cut the carrots, onion, potatoes, bell pepper, parsnip root, and celery. Finely chop the white cabbage. Add the cut vegetables to the pot where the meat is boiling (without potatoes), along with the peas and green beans. Let the soup boil over low heat. When the vegetables and meat are tender, add the potatoes and let them boil for approximately 20 minutes. Then add the tomatoes in broth and bors to taste, depending on how sour you want the soup to be. Let it come to a few boils and add salt to taste. When ready, remove the pot from heat and add finely chopped lovage and parsley.
